scenes.script:
Priya says: "What are you doing?"
Miss Nova says: "I'm adding oil."
Priya says: Woh...
Miss Nova says: "I'm applying oil." Ya aap bol sakte ho, "I'm oiling my hair."
Miss Nova says: Kya aap bhi finally confidently English bolna chahte hain?
Priya says: Haan, par mistakes karne me bohot sharm aati hai.
Miss Nova says: Main hoon Miss Nova. Supernova AI ke saath, aapko tension lene ki koi zaroorat nahi hai.
scenes.on_screen_text:
"What are you doing?"
"I'm adding oil"
"I'm applying oil"
Ya aap bol sakte ho
"I'm oiling my hair"
English bolna chahte ho?
Haan, par sharm aati hai
Supernova AI

scenes.script: Miss Nova says: Aap daily English speaking practice kar sakte ho. 1000 mistakes karo, main aapko kabhi judge nahi karungi, aur koi aapko dekh nahi raha hai.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Daily speaking practice karo
1000 mistakes karo
Zero judgement
Koi nahi dekh raha

scenes.script:
Miss Nova says: Main aapko sikhaungi ki actually out loud baat karke naturally kaise bolte hain.
Priya says: Kya ye actually mere liye kaam karega?
Miss Nova says: Ye purani coaching classes se kahi zyada effective hai, kyunki main aapka exact level analyze karke aapke liye ek personalized plan banati hoon.
Priya says: Kya ye affordable hai?
scenes.on_screen_text:
Naturally bolo
Out loud baat karo
Kya ye mere liye kaam karega?
Coaching classes se behtar
Exact level analyze karein
Personalized plan sirf aapke liye
Kya ye affordable hai?

scenes.script: Miss Nova says: Haan, ye regular classes se saat guna sasta hai. Bas mujhe din me 15 minutes dijiye, aur aap ek month me visible progress dekhne lagenge.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Regular classes se 7x sasta
Bas 15 minutes rozana
Visible progress dekhna shuru karein
Ek month mein

scenes.script: Miss Nova says: Scrolling karke time waste karna band karo. Abhi Supernova AI install karo aur aaj se hi bolna shuru karo.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Scrolling me time waste mat karo
Install Supernova AI
Aaj se hi bolna shuru karo

parsed.self_critique_fixed: Applied the 'Teaching / correction skit' register module. Kept all English teaching lines verbatim in double quotes as per T2a. Applied the T2h comparative multiplier carve-out ('seven times cheaper' -> 'saat guna sasta') and converted numbers to English numerals. Ensured Miss Nova maintains a warm, polite 'aap' register while Priya uses a natural, casual-respectful tone. Romanized the text into standard, clean WhatsApp-style Hindi.

violations.quote: The UI highlights a discounted price of 1 rupee, crossing out the original price of 30.
violations.why: The visual description contains a specific, unapproved rupee price and discount offer which violates the ban on hard pricing.
violations.fix: Update the visual description to show a generic subscription interface or comparative cost graphic instead of specific rupee amounts.

safety.summary: The ad is compliant except for a G6.1 violation in Scene 4 where unapproved hard rupee pricing is shown in the visual.
